<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2007|month=01|day=21|content=

* [[War in Somalia (2006–2009)|War in Somalia]]: [[Sharif Ahmed]], a leader of the defeated [[Islamic Court Union]], surrendered himself to [[Kenyan]] police. [https://web.archive.org/web/20070331061726/http://today.reuters.com/news/articlenews.aspx?type=worldNews (Reuters)]
* [[Sudan]]ese rebels claim that a government aircraft has bombed areas in [[Darfur]] over the weekend in contravention of the ceasefire. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/africa/6285625.stm (BBC)]
* [[2008 United States presidential election|U.S. election 2008]]: [[Bill Richardson]], currently the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] [[Governor of New Mexico]], announces his candidacy for United States president.  [https://www.nytimes.com/2007/01/22/us/politics/22richardson.html?ex=1327122000&en=458cb6118899e167&ei=5088&partner=rssnyt&emc=rss (New York Times)]
* The [[World Wide Fund for Nature|WWF]] warns that some species of [[tuna]] including [[bluefin tuna]] are at risk of commercial extinction due to illegal fishing. [https://web.archive.org/web/20070220061306/http://today.reuters.com/news/articlenews.aspx?type=topNews (Reuters)]
* Dozens of containers, some containing toxic chemicals, are washed ashore at [[Devon]], England after [[MSC Napoli|MSC ''Napoli'']] ran aground on the coast last Thursday during [[Kyrill (storm)|Kyrill]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20070126032855/http://www.abc.net.au/news/newsitems/200701/s1830937.htm (ABC News Australia)]
* [[Palestinian Authority]] President [[Mahmoud Abbas]] and [[Hamas]] leader [[Khaled Mashal]] meet together in [[Syria]] to try to end violence between the two factions. However, differences remain and talks will resume possibly next week. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/6283769.stm (BBC)] [http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory?id=2811528 (AP via ABC News)]
* [[Angela Merkel]], the [[Chancellor of Germany (Federal Republic)|Chancellor of Germany]], holds talks with [[Vladimir Putin]], the [[President of Russia]] over energy security issues. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/business/6285125.stm (BBC)]
* A 7.3 [[Moment magnitude scale|M<sub>w</sub>]] earthquake occurs off of [[Indonesia]], centered in the [[Molucca Sea]]. Buildings shake in northeastern Indonesia, panicking residents, but there are no reports of casualties. [https://earthquake.usgs.gov/eqcenter/eqinthenews/2007/us2007xvam/#details (USGS)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20070216050529/http://today.reuters.com/news/articlenews.aspx?type=newsOne (Reuters)]  [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/asia-pacific/6284339.stm (BBC)]
* [[Muqtada al-Sadr]]'s bloc lifts its boycott of the [[Iraq]]i political process and rejoins the [[government of Iraq from 2006|government]]. [http://www.dailycomet.com/apps/pbcs.dll/article?AID=/20070121/API/701210699 (AP via Daily Comet)]
* Ogün  Samast, who was arrested for murdering [[Hrant Dink]], admits that he has killed Dink. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/6283765.stm (BBC)] [http://edition.cnn.com/2007/WORLD/europe/01/21/turkey.dink/index.html (CNN)]
* Voters in [[Elections in Serbia|Serbia]] participate in the first [[Serbian parliamentary election, 2007|general election]] since it became an independent state in 2006. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/6283551.stm (BBC)]
* Japanese [[tokusatsu]] television series ''[[Kamen Rider Kabuto]]'' ends.
